question: How big should my emergency fund be, and where should I keep it?
answer: Good question! A solid emergency fund usually covers 3 to 6 months of your essential living expenses, like rent, food, bills, and transport. It’s your safety net for unexpected events, so better to be a bit generous if you can. Keep it in a separate, easy-access savings account—not locked away—so you can get to it quickly but won’t be tempted to spend it on daily things. Do you want tips on how to start building it steadily?
ground_truth: 3–6 months’ expenses; options: MMF (Versa, Stashaway), high-interest savings, fixed deposits; pros/cons (access, interest, penalties)
